study: same-league prior H2H Crown AH cover-margin transfer
hypothesis: A target home club may retain matchup-specific performance versus the same opponent beyond its historical Crown handicap, including when venue reverses. Signal is cumulative prior H2H spread residual; no target or future data are used.
temporal_rule: strictly earlier kickoff UTC, same exact league ID and same two team IDs; equal kickoff excluded
quote_source: historical Crown close quote event replay; not a verified pregame HTTP receipt unless separately marked
settlement: correct AH one-unit return, quarter lines split into two equal stakes

actual_receipt_replay.note: Unique FIDs, pre-kickoff actual HTTP receipt, raw and snapshot SHA present, verified FT source; known mismatch FIDs removed. Historical H2H only used events before target kickoff. This is an out-of-sample replay on an already-designed receipt archive, not a live locked strategy.
